bio: Located in a residential area on the Killesberg, this restaurant boasts an inviting rear courtyard terrace and an impressive interior; sleek design, soothing tones and warm wood finishings make for an upscale and tastefully modern setting. Competent service comes courtesy of a charming front-of-house team. Opt for Lacher's Fine Dining Menu (to be ordered in advance) or choose from the appealing à la carte selection. And be sure to order a dessert – the patisserie is very good! Astute wine recommendations are also provided. There are two attractive lounges on the first floor....
